# Segmented

A small set of exclusive choices shown side by side, each with an optional display-face glyph and a hint.

## Anatomy

A bordered grid of equal columns, one button per option, each stacking glyph, label and hint.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` *(required)* | `SegmentedOption<T>[]` | — | — |
| `value` *(required)* | `T` | `$bindable()` | — |
| `label` | `string` | — | Required unless the group is labelled by another element through `labelledby`. |
| `labelledby` | `string` | — | — |
| `compact` | `boolean` | `false` | The reference's compact inline tabs (as in Settings) rather than the full control. |
| `onchange` | `(value: T) => void` | — | — |

## Variants

Two to four options; more belong in a `Select`.

## States

Unselected, selected, disabled, focus-visible.

## Keyboard

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Enters and leaves the group as one stop. |
| `←`, `→` | Move between options and select as they go. |
| `Home`, `End` | Jump to the first and last option. |

## ARIA

`role="radiogroup"` with `role="radio"` children and a roving tabindex, following the WAI-ARIA radio group pattern. The glyph is decorative.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.

## Recorded deviations

| What | Why |
| --- | --- |
| It became a radio group. | The reference renders plain buttons with no role, no group name and no roving tab order, so the choice is not announced as a choice. |
| The inverse hint uses a colour role instead of `opacity: 0.72`. | The composite is the same; stating it as a role is what lets it be contrast-checked. |
| A minimum target height was added. | The reference's 12px padding leaves options under 44px tall on a phone. |
